headline: Wildfire near Kalimati — all routes closed
detail: TNBTS has closed every route pending containment and damage assessment. Do not attempt the climb.

headline: Flooding on the Cemoro Sewu approach road
detail: Heavy rain has flooded the access road below the basecamp. The trail is open but reaching it may be difficult; check locally before travelling.

headline: Savanna fire — fully contained, trail reopened
detail: An example of a resolved advisory. Kept here to show the format; not shown to hikers because its status is resolved.
